notes.distance: Average shortest path length is calculated on the giant component.
notes.models: ER, Watts–Strogatz, and BA are undirected models, so they use the simple undirected projection of the directed Wikipedia links.
notes.ws: Watts–Strogatz uses k=10, the nearest allowed ring degree to the observed mean degree.
notes.ba: Standard BA uses m=5, the nearest allowed integer attachment setting to the observed mean degree.

interpretation.text: The WS model is closest to Marvel's observed clustering, the BA model is closest for maximum degree, and the BA model is closest for path length. Marvel clustering exceeds the degree-preserving null expectation.
